storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Action Story
storyTemplate.description: An action start: reach a threatened checkpoint and respond before the first fight spills into the street.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The first warning is not a siren. It is everyone on the street turning at once.

A checkpoint gate slams down ahead. Someone shouts from behind a delivery truck, glass bursts across the pavement, and people scatter toward alleys on both sides of the road.

The attack is starting now, and the nearest cover is only a few steps away.

starting_known_facts: Runs a sandbox job hub suitable for action stories.
